Assistant B provides a more comprehensive, accurate, and nuanced overview of Japanese business etiquette. It covers additional critical aspects such as the proper handling of business cards (meishi), appropriate bowing depth, use of honorifics, dress code, consensus-based decision-making, non-verbal communication, and the role of after-hours socializing. Assistant A contains some inaccuracies (e.g., handshake as standard greeting, avoiding direct eye contact, and misstating dining norms regarding slurping). Therefore, Assistant B is the better response.
